sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. 

To demonstrate our commitment to this partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to €15.60 per unit, provided we maintain our terms of EXW and 45 days payment. Shifting to DAP and 60 days payment would incur additional costs that would increase the unit price, hence we kept our standard terms to maximize your savings. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

As an alternative, we can offer a price of €15.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW at our standard terms. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
